source: Cocos Creator 3.8.8 release web build captured through an isolated headless Chromium session
matchedBaselineReason: Initial preparation anchors and phase geometry now align after normalizing the original screenshot to its 750x1334 game area. Exact cl1..cl5 cogs, shape panels for all static multi-cell footprints, operation background, backpack panel, open-grid frames, pause/statistics/handbook icons, currency/ticket icons, header counter backgrounds and three bottom buttons are recovered from original assets. The original TsangerYunHei W08 font and the decoded HUD/wave/button outline treatments are also active in the release capture. Original level-5 shape Spine assets and rotation rules are implemented, but the normal reconstruction flow cannot yet create a cross-family level-5 result for a matched capture. Battle was reached through real drag/start interaction and keeps the HUD/backpack visible, but the reference battle uses a developed 863-HP save while this capture starts from 500 HP with one random producer. A same-state trait-selection reconstruction has not yet been captured.

images.notes: Fresh release-build capture with the byte-identical resources3 TsangerYunHei W08 default.ttf and decoded FairyGUI outline treatments: HUD counters #060500/2, wave text #0c0c0c/2 and bottom button titles #000000/3. This validates the visible preparation categories, not every unvisited popup text field. Random candidates remain an uncontrolled weighted draw.

Fresh release-build capture with two random L-shaped candidates directly validating the original panel2 atlas frame, level tint, centre and layer below the cl1 cogs. BagLikeShapeConfig also maps panel1/panel3/panel4 and all required rotations for the remaining static footprints.

Fresh release-build capture with ItemConfig 5/4 runtime bindings restored as the exact dj0002_icon silver coin and dj0005_icon ad ticket SpriteFrames from resources3. The previous gray circle and text glyph substitutes are removed.

Fresh release-build capture with the original comm atlas pause button, battle-statistics and handbook icons, HeaderItem 9-slice counter backgrounds, and blue/green/yellow bottom actions. Currency/ticket foreground icons remain temporary substitutes; random candidates are a valid uncontrolled weighted draw.

Fresh release-build capture using exact bagLike_0 operationBackground, backpackPanel and gezi2 9-slice records in addition to exact cl1 cogs. The asynchronous SpriteFrame size reset was corrected and the recovered 730x529 panel centre was validated. Candidate identities remain a valid uncontrolled weighted draw.

Valid release capture with exact recovered cl1 gear cogs. Backpack begins at design y=300, matching the cropped/scaled original. Candidate identities are intentionally random for challengeTimes=2 and are not a controlled match to the reference draw.

Reached by dragging a candidate into the unlocked 3x3 area and tapping start. Confirms persistent top HUD/backpack, exact cl1 cog art, production progress and spawned units. It is not the same developed save as the original 863-HP battle reference.
